FN-J3QQNFF-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 281
Committee: Banking & Insurance Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/10/2024
Senate Bill 281 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of protected financial information of firearms retailers and firearms
codes pursuant to the provisions of this bill. The increased obligations may be offset, in whole
or in part, by any attorney fees and costs recovered due to violations of the provisions of this bill
and retained by the Attorney General.
In addition, this bill could also increase receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined
amount dependent upon any civil penalties recovered due to violations of this bill in the amount
of $10,000 per violation.

FN-J3QQNFF-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 281
Committee: Financial Services Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/24/2024
Senate Bill 281 as passed the Senate could increase the administrative obligations of the
Attorney General for the enforcement of protected financial information of firearms retailers,
firearm owners, and firearms codes pursuant to the provisions of this bill. The increased
obligations may be offset, in whole or in part, by any attorney fees and costs recovered due to
violations of the provisions of this bill and retained by the Attorney General.
In addition, this bill could also increase receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined
amount dependent upon any civil penalties recovered due to violations of this bill in the amount
of $1,000 per violation.
